messages:
dana: Post-launch review quick thread: after rolling v1.2, we're balancing bug backlog vs requested optimizations. Need to finalize which follow-on milestones go into the next two-week sprint.
harry: Summary: 3 regressions reported, 9 P1s across runtimes, and ~10 enhancement asks (embeds UI, export tweaks, small telemetry changes).
eva: Users care most about stability. Proposed split: 60% bugs+infra, 30% customer-high-ACV enhancements, 10% polish.
eng-lead: Agree on a stability-first approach but would like 1 focused enhancement track for AE-driven work.
dana: Customer ask from XCorp: custom timestamp format on exports + role filter tweak. High priority for sales. Can we handle as small scoped EPIC?
harry: If we scope export change to add optional format param and reuse current serializer, estimate 2 dev-days + QA.
ops-bot: deploy alert: rolling patch deploy started @1768881250 by harry (patch/export-opts-canary).
ops-bot: canary success @1768881256
eva: Decision checklist: 1) Immediate P0 fix assignment 2) 60/30/10 capacity split 3) XCorp export as quick enhancement if fits 2 dev-days 4) deprioritize low-impact polish. Please react with thumbs.
harry: :thumbsup:
dana: :thumbsup:
eva: will pick up XCorp export if privacy signoff from legal is NIL. cc legal.
eng-lead: I'll update the roadmap milestones and freeze M1 scope by EOD.
dana: Adding three tickets: BUG-PR-2010 (P0), M1-cap-split-2011, XCORP-EXPORT-2012. Closing if no objections.
harry: ack, linking PR to BUG-PR-2010 now.
ops-bot: canary promoted to prod @1768881270 (patch/export-opts v1.0.2).
dana: Thanks team — locking plan. We will communicate to customers tomorrow morning.
